title: Shorebirds lifting off
description: A flock of gulls and skimmers rising together off a wide flat beach, pale surf and a soft overcast sky behind them.

title: Palms and crescent moon
description: Coconut palms silhouetted against a graded dawn sky, a thin crescent moon hanging above them and orange light along the sea horizon.

title: Palms at first light
description: The same stand of palms held against a violet-to-amber dawn, the crescent moon high and the ocean just catching the first light.

title: Bottle on the tideline
description: A green glass bottle lying half-buried in wet sand at the tideline, sun bursting through broken cloud over the breaking surf.

title: Beachfront tower at dusk
description: A lit beachfront tower standing over an empty shoreline at dusk, the last band of orange still burning along the horizon.

title: Sargassum at sunrise
description: Thick brown sargassum banked along the waterline at sunrise, the sun a soft disc behind haze and boats sitting far offshore.

title: Ringed planet over the shore
description: A composited scene: an empty beach and grey-blue sea with a vast ringed planet hanging low in the sky at the left of the frame.

title: Palm headland
description: A rocky headland crowded with coconut palms catching low gold light, waves folding onto the sand in the foreground.

title: Palm shadows
description: Long palm shadows thrown across wet sand toward the camera, the green headland and its fringe of trees lit warm beyond.

title: Moonlight through the clouds
description: The moon burning through a torn layer of night cloud, its light laid out in a broken silver path across the sea below.

title: Pool under the moon
description: A lit turquoise pool glowing among dark palms at night, the moon breaking through cloud over the black sea beyond.

title: Pool and palms at first light
description: A resort pool and dense palm grove seen from above at dawn, storm cloud stacked over the ocean and the first orange light on the horizon.

title: Cumulus over the palm coast
description: Towering white cumulus piled over a palm-lined shore, surf running up a narrow strip of dark sand.

title: Coconut on the sand
description: A fallen coconut resting on wet sand in the foreground, the beach curving away past leaning palms under heavy cloud.

title: Red roofs below the treeline
description: Red-tiled roofs scattered through dense green canopy, the sea and a bank of evening cloud stretching along the far horizon.

title: Courts in the green
description: Blue tennis courts set into thick tropical greenery, palms and manicured lawn in the foreground and low hills fading behind.

title: Grey dusk
description: A muted dusk over a quiet beach, layered grey and mauve cloud above dark water and a low rocky point to the left.

title: Foam below the headland
description: White foam spreading across dark sand below a steep green headland, sea grape leaves crowding into the near frame.

title: Sea grape cove
description: A small cove enclosed by a wooded headland, surf washing in over brown sand with sea grape and cactus on the bank above.

title: Moonlit clouds
description: Heavy moonlit cloud filling the night sky above a resort, lit pools and palms glowing far below against the black sea.

title: Behind the cloud bank
description: The moon diffused behind a dense bank of night cloud, a faint silver track running across the water at the bottom of the frame.

title: Morning light along the curve
description: Bright morning sun over a curving beach, clear turquoise shallows on the left and a palm-covered point closing the bay.

title: Sun through the palms
description: The sun flaring in a hard star through overhanging palm crowns, wet sand and gentle surf running along the shore below.

title: Autumn lake
description: Gold and rust autumn trees standing over a flat lake at golden hour, cloud and colour doubled exactly in the still water.

title: Before sunrise
description: Hotel towers and lit streets along a city beachfront before sunrise, the ocean pale and calm out to a soft pink horizon.

title: Everglades channel
description: A wide channel of dark water running between low green banks and sawgrass under bright midday cumulus.

title: Boardwalk under a full moon
description: A wooden boardwalk running down to an empty beach under a full moon, its light laid in a bright column across the sea.

title: Pink dawn
description: A broad hard-packed beach at dawn, pink and violet cloud spread across the sky and condo towers receding into haze on the left.

title: Sunrise on wet sand
description: Orange dawn light reflected in a sheet of water left on the flat sand, distant walkers scattered along the empty shore.

title: Dawn surf
description: A slow hold on low dawn surf rolling up a wide flat beach, pastel cloud lying along the horizon behind it.

title: Walkers at sunrise
description: A vivid orange and gold sunrise over the breakers, a few early walkers silhouetted along the wet sand.

title: Quiet dawn
description: A steady view along the waterline at first light, muted cloud overhead and thin surf sliding over the packed sand.

title: Sunrise over the breakers
description: The sun sitting half-risen on the horizon in a deep orange sky, its light running in a broken line across the incoming surf.

title: Midday surf
description: Bright midday surf breaking in clean lines onto pale sand, thin cirrus streaking a hard blue sky above.

title: Lone tree above the rocks
description: A single broad-crowned tree standing on clipped lawn above a rocky shoreline, the sea flat and grey under heavy overcast.

title: Palapa in the late sun
description: A thatched palapa and empty loungers on white sand, palms leaning over a calm turquoise bay in hazy late sun.

title: Loungers facing the sun
description: Blue loungers lined up on the sand facing a low sun, its light spread in a wide sheet across the shallow bay.

title: Soft sun over the shallows
description: The sun diffused behind thin cloud above a shallow turquoise bay, low villas and palms sitting along the far point.

title: Villas along the point
description: White villas and palms strung along a low point enclosing a calm bay, the sun burning through cloud out over open water.

title: Golden hour volleyball
description: Sun low over the water with loungers and a volleyball net standing on empty sand, palm fronds framing the top of the frame.

title: Sinking over the reef
description: A long hold as the sun drops toward the horizon, its gold path rippling across water breaking gently over a low reef.

title: Behind the buoy line
description: The sun setting beyond a line of white marker buoys, the sea turning from gold to pewter as the light goes.

title: Pink dusk
description: Pink and grey dusk cloud over a calm bay, lit villas along the shore and the last colour fading behind a low headland.

title: Catamaran offshore
description: A brightly painted catamaran anchored in vivid turquoise water off a long white beach, palms crowding the shoreline behind.

title: Swimmers in the shallows
description: Swimmers and small boats scattered across clear turquoise shallows, a marker line of floats running out from the pale sand.

title: Green hills from the water
description: A palm-fringed shoreline seen from offshore, forested hills rising behind it under a flat grey sky.

title: Glitter path
description: The sun burning through broken cloud over open ocean, throwing a wide field of glitter across the dark swell below.

title: Night heron
description: A yellow-crowned night heron picking its way along a weed-covered rock shelf at the water's edge.

title: Rocky cove
description: A small sandy cove enclosed by a low rock spur, palms leaning in from the right under a deep blue sky.

title: Lawn above the water
description: Clipped lawn and broad-crowned trees on a low bluff above a rocky shore, deep blue ocean running flat to the horizon.

title: Over the reef shallows
description: A snorkel-level drift over patchy reef in clear blue water, sergeant majors moving through the coral heads below.

title: Sergeant majors
description: Striped sergeant majors hanging over a broken reef floor, a snorkeler passing along the surface above.

title: Coral heads
description: A slow pass across scattered coral heads and pale sand, small fish scattering as the camera moves over them.

title: Looking down on the reef
description: A downward view tracking across textured reef and rubble, light rippling over the bottom in shifting bands.

title: Reef floor
description: A close, slow drift directly above the reef floor, algae and coral texture filling the whole frame.

title: Diving down
description: A free-diver in fins descending toward the reef, trailing bubbles as the seabed opens out below.

title: Reef texture
description: An overhead drift across dense reef growth, dark coral and pale sand alternating beneath the surface light.

title: Sunlight across the reef
description: Surface light playing over a shallow reef shelf, the water shifting from green to blue as the camera moves.

title: Drifting over the rubble
description: A steady drift above broken coral rubble and sand, occasional fish moving in and out of the frame.

title: Reef and open blue
description: The reef falling away into open blue water, coral heads standing out against the deeper channel beyond.

title: Snorkelling the reef
description: A handheld snorkel pass over a shallow reef, the seabed rising and falling as the swell carries the camera.

title: Reef from above
description: A vertical frame looking straight down through clear blue water onto a mottled reef of coral and pale sand.

title: Slow drift
description: A slow-motion drift across coral heads in bright blue water, small striped fish holding station over the reef.

title: Reef below the surface
description: A wide underwater view of a reef in clear blue water, the mirrored surface overhead and a snorkeler at the top right.
